trap.label: so/such
trap.wrong: She is so irritable what relationships suffer.
trap.right: She is so irritable that relationships suffer.
trap.why: Português “tão irritada que”; o brasileiro troca por what. Em inglês so… that / such a… that.

mcq.q: such a long day **___** I slept:
It was **___** an awful day that…

fix.wrong: It was so a bad day that I cried.
fix.right: It was such a bad day that I cried.

fix.wrong: I was so tired what I slept.
fix.right: I was so tired that I slept.

fix.wrong: She is such irritable that we left.
fix.right: She is so irritable that we left.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “I was tired. I slept.” (so… that)
rewrite.answer: I was so tired that I slept.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “It was a bad day. I cried.” (such a… that)
rewrite.answer: It was such a bad day that I cried.

rewrite.prompt: Una: “He is irritable. People leave.” (so… that)
rewrite.answer: He is so irritable that people leave.
